scenarios.title: 'Something went wrong' at checkout after a coupon
expected_path: Triage: no duplicate (BUG-1207 is a different issue, wont_fix); unclear class; asks Espida
Espida: backend 200s plus client crash app.checkout.discount_row_crash -> frontend; impact 3410 users (android 3000, ios 410); Triage asks Kinetics to reproduce
Kinetics asks Telios; Telios gets android-18.2 (github_actions, 18 min)

Telios: create_user android-18.2-PNQ-G3-gold_monthly -> set_address PNQ -> set_group G3 -> activate_plan gold_monthly -> fill_cart R-3391 -> apply_coupon SAVE50 (asks Triage for the code; only the journey has it)
Kinetics: android-18.2 on redmi-note-10, cart/open + checkout/open -> reproduced; reports to Atlas
Atlas: culprit CHG-411 (app 18.2, android + ios; CHG-412 is a service distractor); Gremlin quotes PRD-CHECKOUT-V3 (label optional) -> frontend; scope android + ios
Baselines on the next release: Telios makes an iOS twin (ios-18.5-PNQ-G3-gold_monthly, same calls); Kinetics: android-18.6-rc1 on redmi-note-10 and ios-18.6-rc1 on an iPhone -> reproduced on both
Atlas: POST /atlas/fixes frontend checkout, platforms android + ios, culprit CHG-411 -> android-18.6-rc1-atlas-1 and ios-18.6-rc1-atlas-1
Kinetics: both Atlas builds, same users, devices and steps -> not_reproduced (verified on both platforms)

Gremlin: checks culprit fit and platform coverage; PRD-CHECKOUT-V3 update + known issue, app-18.6 note, reply in #checkout-v3, inform checkout-fe, RCA to Triage; Triage tells the reporter the fix ships in 18.6
unexpected_paths: Telios skips the coupon -> not_reproduced, observed: no coupon is applied
Kinetics uses an ios build with this android mock user -> 422
Espida filters source=client -> only the crash entries
Atlas fixes android only -> Gremlin sees ios in the impact split and in CHG-411's platforms, and sends it back to Atlas
Atlas names CHG-412 as the culprit -> its builds still reproduce (verification fails)

prds.title: Checkout v3: discounts and coupons
prds.summary: One checkout screen that shows every discount (Gold, coupons, offers) as its own row.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Members see exactly which discounts apply and how much each one saves.

sections.heading: Contract
sections.body: GET /checkout/summary returns discounts[]. Each row has type and amount. label is required for gold and offer rows and optional for coupon rows; the app shows the coupon code when label is missing.

sections.heading: Rollout
sections.body: Live from 18.2 on android and ios.
